title: besleria aggregata var. loretensis

The health benefits of Loretto besleria include its potential anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in wound healing and protection against infections. The plant's therapeutic actions are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which have been studied for their potential to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
